_about: Failure-count baselines for scripts/ratchet.mjs and the browser-free probes. A count may only fall: the ratchet fails when one rises above its baseline, and `node scripts/ratchet.mjs --update` lowers a baseline to the count measured, never raises it. Browser suites are measured by hand (one browser slot) and passed in with --counts; each entry names where its baseline was recorded.
